description: Marathon runner (32 mpw, 5 days) who explicitly wants to keep 2x/week strength training. Initial plan must schedule runs on non-strength days or at minimum not double up hard efforts — and the 5 run days must not conflict with existing S&C days.

user.name: Jordan
user.experience_level: intermediate — running 4 years, multiple halfs (PR 1:55), first marathon
user.notes: Wants to keep strength training 2x/week — currently lifts on Tuesday and Friday. HARD CONSTRAINTS: (1) Friday is gym-only — NO run on Friday under any circumstances. (2) Tuesday has lifting — Tuesday runs must be easy and short (5–6 miles max); NO tempo, intervals, or any quality work on Tuesday. (3) Quality sessions (tempo, marathon-pace work) belong on Thursday. Goal is to finish and enjoy the experience — no time goal.

forbidden_content: scheduling a hard quality session (tempo or intervals) on Tuesday when Jordan also lifts
scheduling any run on Friday (Jordan's gym day — no run on Friday)
ignoring the strength training constraint entirely
scheduling both a tempo AND an interval session in the same week during peak training (too much quality load combined with 2x/week lifting)
ground_truth.notes: 20-week first marathon plan for a 32 mpw runner who cross-trains with strength. Friday is lift-only — no run. Tuesday has lifting too so Tuesday runs must be easy/short (5-6mi max, no tempo). Running days: Mon, Tue (easy only), Thu, Sat, Sun. Long run on Saturday or Sunday. Tempo on Thursday. The plan should explicitly acknowledge S&C integration. Peak week 42-50mi is appropriate given the cross-training load. Jordan's goal is completion, not time — no need for aggressive volume.
